description: Change an application in the user's job tracker: status (saved, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected), notes, salary, follow-up date (yyyy-mm-dd) and note, location, job link or the CV used. Moving to "applied" saves a snapshot of the CV as sent. Only the fields given change. Use when the user applies, hears back or wants a follow-up reminder.

cvId.description: The CV used for this application.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

nextActionAt.description: Follow-up date yyyy-mm-dd, or empty to clear it.

nextActionNote.description: What to do on the follow-up date.

notes.description: The user's notes (replaces the current notes).

status.description: New status (the application moves to the end of that column).

name: update_takemeup_application
title: Update a job application
